description: The Petromap API offers fuel prices, station locations and station network and amenity information across Europe to developers of apps, dashboards and tools. The developer page presents use cases such as fuel finders, home dashboards with fuel price alongside weather, route planners, fleet dashboards and research or market visualisations, and says prices can be shown in the developer's preferred currency. Access works by requesting developer access, after which approved users manage API keys and track usage; a pricing page exists but was not read, so cost is recorded as on request. The page notes that coverage and available fields vary by country and station and points to the API documentation for details. Coverage is Europe, with the countries and update frequency not listed on the page read. Access: commercial API by request. Caveats: no licence or data provenance is stated on the developer page, so redistribution terms are unknown. It suits fuel market analysis and capacity planning of refuelling infrastructure, and relates to the EU Weekly Oil Bulletin record catalogued here.
